Brief

Caption must say “3rd-i”

Caption must include #3rdiapp

End every post with the CTA line: Download "3rd-i: Safety In Real Time" on the App Store. Put it in the caption and a pinned comment too.

Never show the Nudge screen. Slide 4 shows a main feature: dual cam with map, Trip Mode, SOS or SOS for a friend.

No clipping or reposting 3rd-i's own videos. Original slideshows only.

Content requirements

Add link in bio
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/3rd-i-safety-in-real-time/id1660727893
Copy link

Use caption
"3rd-i"

The text goes in the caption, not a comment

Put it in the caption itself. A comment does not count. It can sit anywhere in a longer caption, and the brand looks for it when reviewing your post.

Creator requirements

- No stolen content

- No same hooks

- No same scripts

- No spamming

- Must mention #3rdiapp in your description

- 3rdi's CTA should be in 3rd or 4th slide

- No same hooks photo

- Scripts should be unique(Use claude for that)

- Must write something about 3rdi in your description
